ui.description: Understand the world's promise, rule boundaries, main forces and story stage from the reader's view.
ui.promiseFallback: Once the world handbook is filled in, this becomes a world sample reusable by novels.
ui.summaryFallback: Add a one-line world overview so creators grasp it quickly.
ui.conflictFallback: With a core conflict, the system can more easily turn the world into pressure that keeps driving the plot.
ui.identity: Boundaries of identity, factions and taboo combinations.
ui.stage: Opening locations, upgrade paths and conflict sources.
ui.rules: Rules to keep following while writing.
ui.priority: Follow first when used for this book
ui.ruleSummary: Core rules constrain character identity, conflict sources and world consistency.
ui.noTaboo: No taboo combinations recorded. Add them in handbook editing when strong constraints are needed.
ui.notReady: The world handbook is still being completed
ui.notReadyHint: Let AI or handbook editing organize the world skeleton first, then use it as a reusable world sample.
ui.notReadyDescription: The world handbook organizes scattered settings into rules, forces, locations and plot pressure so authors understand it and novels can use it.
ui.assetDescription: Maps and graphs are visual assets of the world handbook; they don't auto-overwrite on sync and don't replace the rule source.
ui.mapDescription: Regions, location connectivity, story sites and conflict intensity.
ui.factionsDescription: Faction nodes, ally/enemy links, control relations and power comparison.
ui.timelineDescription: Historical events, shifting situations and the world's progress as the novel advances.
ui.powerDescription: Realms, resources, costs, taboos and breakthrough limits.
